canonical_definition: A benchmark and dataset of 2,000 ambiguous questions with condition-answer-citation triples, designed to evaluate models' ability to resolve ambiguity through explicit condition identification and conditional answer generation.
papers: CondAmbigQA: A Benchmark and Dataset for Conditional Ambiguous Question Answering

relationships.evidence: CondAmbigQA emphasises ambiguity resolution, explicitly capturing possible clarifications for ambiguous questions. This allows for a structured evaluation of how effectively models recognise, interpret, and resolve ambiguity by interpreting distinct possible meanings. (Section 3.4)
